verdict: Yes, especially in North India. Gabru Di Chaap from Hyderabad pitched flavourful soya chaap on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Soya chaap is a popular vegetarian street food with good margins, and a small menu keeps operations simple.
angle: Soya chaap is a favourite with vegetarians in Delhi and Punjab and is spreading to other cities. Tandoori, malai and afghani varieties sell well. Kiosks and delivery apps are the main channels.
